articles.title: Design of a compact, fast-switching high-voltage pulser for high-repetition-rate miniature time-of-flight mass spectrometers
articles.authors: Cao G, Huang Y, Zhu L, Zhou Z, Qi F
articles.summary: To meet the demand for miniaturized, low-power high-voltage pulse power supplies for time-of-flight mass spectrometers (TOF-MS), we designed a compact half-bridge push-pull pulse power supply. The power supply achieves a frequency range of 1-100 kHz, a maximum output voltage of 800 V, pulse-width adjustment in 0.1 μs steps, and a power consumption of ∼10 W. Electrical characterization shows that the rise time is less than 10 ns, overshoot is below 5%, amplitude and period stability are excellent, and the synchronization between positive and negative pulses is reliable. …
